title: Apache web server process terminated
description: Production website is unavailable and returning connection refused error. Apache service appears inactive.

title: Nginx proxy returning HTTP 502 bad gateway
description: Users are encountering 502 Bad Gateway and connection refused errors when accessing the web portal via Nginx.

title: PostgreSQL database connection refused
description: Backend services cannot connect to PostgreSQL database. Application queries are failing with connection timeout.

title: MySQL service unreachable on default port 3306
description: Application database errors reported across multiple microservices. MySQL connection refused.

title: Root storage partition disk space full
description: Disk usage above threshold on primary volume. Application unable to write temporary files and logs.

title: Intermittent packet loss on internal subnet
description: Employees experiencing high latency and packet loss when reaching internal gateway services.

title: Internal hostname DNS resolution failing
description: Workstations cannot resolve internal domains. Unknown host error returned during DNS queries.

title: Web application backend not responding
description: Application service inactive with HTTP 500 errors. System process stopped responding to requests.

title: Users receiving stale outdated cache data
description: Application rendering inconsistent old data due to corrupted application cache entries.

title: HTTPS browser certificate expired warning
description: Users receiving TLS handshake failure and certificate expired warnings when navigating to the portal.

title: CPU utilization consistently spiking at 100 percent
description: High CPU usage diagnostic required. Server slow and requests timing out due to heavy compute load.

title: Out of memory errors causing service crash
description: Memory usage elevated with out of memory errors reported in syslog. System becoming sluggish.
